about: LOD 400 steel door: RHS 40x40 frame with transom and louvred or glazed vent over, sheet leaf with stiffener ribs, optional half-glazed upper leaf with grille bars, single, equal or unequal pair. Type-dependent parts collapse into the left jamb through Yes/No-driven formulas (no visibility-parameter op yet). The recipe puts its outer face at -y, but the template's plane named Exterior is at +y (field review, 15 Oct): the Revit retest confirms which way the family faces in a wall; leaf flush with the interior face, swings in. Profile slot (gen_profile_slots.py): FMC_Design_Movement (1-20, default 17) shows one of 20 Architrave sweeps (Ext and Int faces) from FMC_Profile_Architrave_<Token>, each bound to Show_<Token>. Each sweep's path is locked to Left, Right, Frame Head and Floor (path_planes) on Trim Face Ext/Trim Face Int, so the trims follow Width and Height in every type.

ops.name: 0900x2400_Sheet-Louvre300/FMC_Frame_Spec

ops.name: Leaf B L Offset
ops.formula: if(Pair, Frame Width + Main Leaf Width + Meeting Gap, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Leaf B R Offset
ops.formula: if(Pair, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Rib B L Offset
ops.formula: if(Pair, Frame Width + Main Leaf Width + Meeting Gap + Rib Margin, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Rib B R Offset
ops.formula: if(Pair, Width - Frame Width - Rib Margin, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Upper L Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Glazed, Hide Offset, Frame Width)

ops.name: Upper R Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Glazed, Hide Offset + Hide Width, Frame Width + Main Leaf Width)

ops.name: Rib U L Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Glazed, Hide Offset, Frame Width + Rib Margin)

ops.name: Rib U R Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Glazed, Hide Offset + Hide Width, Frame Width + Main Leaf Width - Rib Margin)

ops.name: Bar 1 L Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Leaf Glazed, Leaf Grille), Frame Width + Stile Width + 1 * (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) / 4 - Bar Width / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 1 R Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Leaf Glazed, Leaf Grille), Frame Width + Stile Width + 1 * (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) / 4 + Bar Width / 2, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Bar 2 L Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Leaf Glazed, Leaf Grille), Frame Width + Stile Width + 2 * (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) / 4 - Bar Width / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 2 R Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Leaf Glazed, Leaf Grille), Frame Width + Stile Width + 2 * (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) / 4 + Bar Width / 2, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Bar 3 L Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Leaf Glazed, Leaf Grille), Frame Width + Stile Width + 3 * (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) / 4 - Bar Width / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 3 R Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Leaf Glazed, Leaf Grille), Frame Width + Stile Width + 3 * (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) / 4 + Bar Width / 2, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Louvre L Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Frame Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Louvre R Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Glass L Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Hide Offset, Frame Width)

ops.name: Glass R Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Hide Offset + Hide Width, Width - Frame Width)

ops.name: Mesh R Offset
ops.formula: if(FMC_Mosquito_Mesh, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: FMC_Glazed_Area_m2
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Fanlight Height - Transom Depth - Frame Width) * if(Vent Louvred, 0, 1) + (Main Leaf Width - 2 * Stile Width) * Vision Height * if(Leaf Glazed, 1, 0)
